card.name: Small words in cooking recipe steps
card.fires_on: Small words such as a, of, to, in and numerals like 1 or 2 inside recipe instructions, right before a food or cooking item or a time or size. Also fires in mixing-with-applesauce dosing directions.

modes.label: Article or preposition before food
modes.description: A small word like a, of, to or in comes just before a food, sauce or liquid in a cooking step.
modes.example: Make<< a>> stock of white wine, fish fum

modes.label: Number in recipe quantity
modes.description: A numeral such as 1 or 2 appears in an ingredient amount, size or cooking time.
modes.example: Increase heat to high and allow wine to simmer until thickened and slightly reduced, about <<2>> minutes.

modes.label: Applesauce mixing directions
modes.description: The word of follows a teaspoon amount in directions to mix a drug with applesauce.
modes.example: mix with 1 teaspoonful<< of>> room temperature applesauce.

card.plain: It lights up on little words and numbers in recipe steps, just before the food or amount comes up.
